summary: Beeline Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Beeline Financial Holdings, acquired MagicBlocks via a Securities Exchange Agreement. Prior to closing, Beeline owned 47.6% of MagicBlocks; post-closing, MagicBlocks became a wholly-owned subsidiary. Consideration: BFH acquired all MagicBlocks common stock from selling shareholders for nominal cash; Beeline issued 211,679 shares at $2.25/share to third-party SAFE holders (~$476K principal). A Special Committee of disinterested directors approved the related-party transaction. CEO Nicholas Liuzza, a SAFE holder, received 31,111 shares on same terms. Watch for shareholder litigation risk given the CEO's participation and the $2.25 price described as materially above market.
